title: Gooey Pancake Stack
description: A stack of fluffy pancakes with a gooey center, topped with a sweet and tangy jjammy sauce.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together jjammy and gooey until well combined.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Cook pancakes according to package instructions or until bubbles appear on surface.
Flip pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Place cooked pancakes on a serving plate and top with jjammy-gooey mixture.
If using jcure, sprinkle on top of pancakes for added flavor.
